purpose: Document Elenga's official Bangladesh land-record custodians and inspect the current public digital land-map viewer and configured GIS services for safe anonymous parcel geometry.
assessment: Elenga is identified by official Kalihati/Tangail pages as a municipality in Kalihati Upazila. The Kalihati Upazila Land Office and Tangail Zonal Settlement Office establish local/state land-record custody. The current map.land.gov.bd viewer exposes anonymous administrative and geometry routes in JavaScript, but Tangail was not returned in the tested administrative result and the configured official GeoServer WMS/WFS metadata endpoints returned HTTP 503. No parcel geometry was retained and no absence inference was made.
registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastre custody is evidenced by the official Upazila Land Office and Tangail Zonal Settlement Office pages. This does not verify public parcel geometry, title, ownership, or citywide coverage.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Bangladesh land-record/map portal configuration, bounded anonymous endpoint checks, and official Kalihati/Tangail custodian pages.

attempts: Fetched the official map.land.gov.bd viewer over HTTPS and inspected its current JavaScript/configuration.
The viewer identifies POST /getAdminByCode and /getGeomByCode routes; its plot response handler reads safe candidate fields gid, plot_no_en, and geom WKT. No Elenga parcel response was obtained.
Anonymous POST division lookup returned seven divisions; division 30 district lookup returned Gopalganj, Kishoreganj, and Shariatpur only.
Anonymous POST thana lookups for tested Tangail candidate codes 3093, 3090, and 3091 each returned an empty JSON array; this is not an absence finding.
Fetched configured official GIS WMS and wsDMMS WFS GetCapabilities endpoints. Both returned HTTP 503 and no schema.
Fetched the official Ministry of Land citizen-services URL; it returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge response. No bypass was attempted.
Official Kalihati Upazila and Tangail Zonal Settlement Office pages were reviewed for local custodian evidence.
